clauses.clause: Until pickup: 0 infected, 0 combat, 0 damage decals; ≥ 40 civilians in routines at high, ≥ 30 at low (orchestrator 2026-11-04: low follows the L4-04 50 % low budget, 30–35; the old ≥ 40 at low contradicted L4-04); soldiers relaxed (chat/coffee/patrol). Civilians do not clump outside the camp or overlap.
clauses.note: Fresh physical reception low32/high64 civilians;13/14 half-second plaza samples. Zero infected, damage decals, combat windups or engaged soldiers; every civilian has calm purposeful activity. Minimum normal-human centre separation0.713771/0.702961m exceeds0.7m summed radii. Six current frames personally inspected at both zooms/tiers: clean camp/shops, lowered guard rifles, separated people. Outside connected groups of6/12 are orderly queues alongside the second bus, not overlapping clumps; a camera-only replay matches the physical positions exactly. The convoy ride is excluded from this quartermaster-phase census.
